name: ThreeBarReversal

shortCondition: el_gt(close[2], open[2]) && el_lt(close[0], open[0]) && el_lt(close[0], (high[2] + low[2]) / 2) && el_ge(high[0] - low[0], sizeRatio * (high[2] - low[2])) && el_le(high[1] - low[1], middleBarMaxFraction * avgRng)
